operation.description:
Gets the current status of a GitHub Pages deployment.

The authenticated user must have read permission for the GitHub Pages site.
operation.summary: Get the status of a GitHub Pages deployment

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/pages-deployment.description: The ID of the Pages deployment. You can also give the commit SHA of the deployment.
#/components/parameters/pages-deployment.name: pages_deployment_id

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

status.description: The current status of the deployment.
